note: Curated product base for /report/stablecoin-yield-ranking, transcribed from the target-products sheet. This REPLACES Portals discovery as the ranking base: the report shows exactly these products, split into two editorial tiers. `tier: high-yield` is the upper block of the sheet; `tier: stable` is the 'user favorite, stable-paying landscape' block, framed as places to park liquidity. scripts/fetch-stablecoin-products.mjs hydrates each row's share price, realized rate and TVL onchain via scripts/lib/share-price.mjs. shareDecimals/underlyingDecimals are cached here because token decimals never change; every pair below was read from chain, not assumed (Fusion vaults really are 8-decimal shares over 6-decimal USDC, which is the trap that silently reports a 1.128 share price as 0.011).

products.name: aHYPER Looping Vault
products.description: An auto-looping vault for aHYPER, the Hyperithm delta-neutral vault, giving leveraged exposure to the underlying strategy. It inherits aHYPER's risks (delta-neutral execution, funding-fee volatility, counterparty, smart contract) and adds those of an isolated lending market: onchain lending risk, oracle or market misconfiguration, and collateral liquidation. The rate is driven by the spread between aHYPER's yield and the USDC borrowing cost, multiplied by the leverage factor, so a negative spread amplifies losses just as a positive one amplifies gains. Unwinding depends on USDC liquidity in the relevant Morpho market and on aHYPER redemption liquidity.

products.name: 40 Acres Autocompounder
products.description: Supplies USDC to the 40 Acres lending vault, earning USDC interest. At every harvest the earned rewards are converted into more USDC.

products.name: Arcadia USDC Autocompounder
products.description: Supplies USDC to Arcadia Lend, earning USDC interest. At every harvest the earned rewards are converted into more USDC.

products.name: Bitcoin Dollar USDC
products.description: Generates yield by acquiring sBTCD, a yield-bearing token collateralized 50% BTC and 50% USD. The vault leverages that token 2x by borrowing wBTC at a 50% LTV. The BTC exposure inside sBTCD is offset by the wBTC debt, leaving holders with USD exposure plus the yield.

products.name: Prime HELOC Loop
products.description: Converts PYUSD into PRIME, supplies PRIME as collateral and borrows PYUSD to reach 5x target leverage (80% LTV) on the Morpho PRIME-PYUSD market. PRIME provides exposure to Figure's onchain private-credit infrastructure through Hastra, with yield generated from lending backed by Figure-originated HELOC collateral. Execution uses flashloans, and LTV may temporarily rise to 84% when PRIME trades below NAV before delevering back toward target.

products.name: Wintermute Trading USD Coin
products.description: An open-term undercollateralized credit market where Wintermute, a global algorithmic trading firm and OTC desk, borrows USDC directly from lenders. Unlike every other row here the rate is a fixed lender APR set by the market's parameters rather than a floating figure, and the position is a claim on a named borrower rather than on collateral: there is no overcollateralization behind it. Access is restricted on both deposit and withdrawal, with a 24-hour withdrawal cycle and a 48-hour grace period.

source.aprNote: Effective lender APR published by the market itself, not a measured onchain rate.

products.name: Fluid Lite USD Vault
products.description: Earns through automated leveraged looping, borrowing against yield-bearing stablecoin collateral such as sUSDe, syrupUSDC, syrupUSDT and sUSDai on Fluid and Aave across Ethereum, Arbitrum and Plasma. A 500K USDC reserve fund buffers temporary underperformance, and a 0.05% withdrawal fee applies.

products.name: mHYPER
products.description: A tokenized strategy tracking a set of market-neutral stablecoin strategies deployed across onchain markets, managed by Hyperithm with ongoing oversight of risk parameters, and issued by Midas Software GmbH under an EU Prospectus Regulation public offer. DeFi integrations include Pendle, Morpho, Contango and Euler.

source.note: Not ERC-4626: exposes neither asset() nor convertToAssets(). Rate is shown only when a NAV source can be read onchain; otherwise the row states the rate is unavailable rather than guessing.

products.name: Avantis USDC Vault
products.description: The avUSDC vault is the counterparty to every trade on Avantis, so lenders earn a share of platform trading fees and, by construction, take the other side of trader profit and loss. Withdrawal fees are dynamic and rise when excess liquidity in the vault is low. Subject to drawdowns.

products.name: Aave v3 USDC Market
products.description: Lenders earn interest paid by borrowers who post collateral and take overcollateralized loans from the pool. The supply rate floats with utilization: the share of supplied USDC actually being borrowed. The deepest and longest-running venue in this report.

source.note: The sheet listed a vaults.fyi opportunity id here; the address above is the real USDC reserve asset, read through the Aave v3 Ethereum Pool.

products.name: Staked USDe
products.description: The yield-bearing form of USDe, Ethena's synthetic dollar. USDe backing mixes staked ETH collateral, stablecoin and RWA reserves, and institutional lending positions. Yield comes from ETH staking rewards, funding rates on delta-hedged short perpetual futures, and interest on reserves. Deposited USDe converts to sUSDe, which appreciates as protocol earnings compound, which is why its share price is well above 1.

products.name: syrupUSDC
products.description: A tokenized claim on overcollateralized institutional loans. USDC supplied to Syrup mints syrupUSDC, which appreciates against USDC as borrowers pay interest. Loans require continuous borrower collateralization with active margin calls, and a dynamic liquidity buffer supports near-instant withdrawals. Used as collateral across Aave, Morpho, Kamino and Pendle, and deployed on Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, Base and Plasma.

products.name: Savings USDS
products.description: Sky pays yield to USDS supplied to the Sky Savings Rate module. The rate is funded by the protocol's excess reserves, generated by fees paid by overcollateralized borrowers who mint against collateralized debt positions. No borrower sits opposite an individual holder: the rate is a governance-set distribution of protocol revenue.
